stories.title: 8 confirmed dead in Sierra Nevada avalanche
stories.summary: Eight skiers in the Castle Peak avalanche near Lake Tahoe are confirmed to be deceased.

stories.title: U.S. military buildup continues as Iran faces possible strikes
stories.summary: The U.S. is sending even more Navy ships and top-of-the-line warplanes into the Middle East. This comes as the U.S. and Iran are talking about that country's nuclear program.

stories.title: Curling builds community in rural Massachusetts
stories.summary: In tiny Petersham, Mass., a volunteer-run curling club is a gathering place for people of all ages who love to curl and hang out.

stories.title: In China, a meme is worth a thousand words
stories.summary: As China celebrates the lunar new year, the year of the horse has taken on an uncanny association with Draco Malfoy of the Harry Potter series.

stories.title: Wrapping snow in blankets. Can that save the ski season?
stories.summary: Warming temperatures and no snow are also a problem in Western states, where winter sports are a billion-dollar industry. One ski area in Idaho is experimenting with insulated blankets, which keep snow from melting over the summer.

stories.title: Mass grave sheds light on 7th century plague
stories.summary: In modern-day Jordan, a 1500-year old mass grave sheds light on the lives of people affected by the Plague of Justinian.
